## Geopolitics

### US pauses Iran military strikes, markets rally on reduced tensions
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ The president of the United States paused military strikes on Iran after 13 consecutive nights of bombing, with both sides halting attacks to allow ceasefire negotiations, sending oil prices tumbling and stock futures surging.

- Pause began Friday, July 25, 2026, continued through Sunday
- Brent crude fell to $90.90, down ~7% from over $100
- S&P 500 futures up over 2%; Dow futures up 930-1,300 points
- US maintains naval blockade of Iranian ports despite pause
- Pause followed concerns over depleting US weapons stockpiles
